integrity: Complete analytic proof of all-parameter asymptotics; accompanying standard-library finite checks are independent of the proof of infinite limits. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-cosine-derivative-weight unit-circle family only, lambda>0, 0<c<1/2. Exterior first correction and uniform coefficient estimates; no general two-measure theorem. The closest published 2026 critical-scale theorem has an incompatible measure-only leading prediction for this class. Earlier unlocated equivalent results remain possible.
title: Critical Sobolev circle polynomials: an effective-weight limit and a sharp first correction
